title: Correct paid-job ticket expected value for high-price work units
description: A real 3-second transcription open advertises 1000 wei per second and LOC reports funded_value_wei=3000, but the payer mints ticket_face_value=3000 and the payee credits only 2 wei expected value. The broker therefore refuses with insufficient_balance before backend execution. Two fresh jobs reproduced the same mismatch. This blocks any capability whose per-job price exceeds the ticket EV accidentally produced.
acceptance_criteria: For a 3-second transcription at 1000 wei/second, the minted envelope credits at least the full 3000 wei funded ceiling at the payee; broker executes the backend; signed settlement claims 3 seconds; LOC bills 3000 wei. Tests cover face value, win probability, credited expected value, and rounding for low and high prices.
notes:
Live evidence, two independent opens: LOC job 07f3c3fe-e076-4f92-bfe3-8c5ec3f504e0 / request c9d907d4-2111-4a07-983c-7209b1a3b744 and LOC job 8729caf1-d5cc-4740-8026-5b29a47a9362 / request ec2a442c-ecd1-4ce1-b4fb-2b9c7656d30b. Payer log: funded_value_wei=3000 ticket_face_value=3000. Payee log: credited_ev_wei=2, balance 2 then 4. Broker log: 402 insufficient_balance, work_units=0. Backend on 127.0.0.1:9411 independently returns 200 for the same multipart WAV.
2026-08-23 live recheck: same fresh transcription job minted funded_value_wei=3000 / ticket_face_value=3000, while payee credited_ev_wei=2 (cumulative balance 6) and broker refused insufficient_balance. LOC request 7141eb8d-d8d8-46a7-952a-6223757a31c4. Still release-blocking.

title: Return compliant signed terminal evidence for broker funding refusals
description: On a paid multipart request the broker logs status=402 livepeer_error=insufficient_balance and work_units=0, but the HTTP error omits Livepeer-Work-Units: 0 (and usable signed terminal evidence). The gateway correctly rejects the response as protocol_response_invalid; GET /v1/exchange/{request_id} returns ADMITTED_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN. This violates the paid-job/v1 rule that every terminal response, including errors, carries an explicit zero-unit claim and leaves LOC without attributable terminal settlement.
acceptance_criteria: All post-open broker refusals return the required request/job/work-unit headers with Livepeer-Work-Units: 0 and produce the protocol-defined signed terminal record retrievable by job ID and request ID. Conformance covers insufficient_balance on unary, stream, and multipart and proves no backend execution or fabricated debit.
notes:
Reproduction: submit the published wav-16k-mono-3s.wav through gateway POST /v1/audio/transcriptions with model=default. Gateway opens 3-unit multipart job, then receives a 402 whose missing zero claim becomes protocol_response_invalid. Broker requests c9d907d4-2111-4a07-983c-7209b1a3b744 and ec2a442c-ecd1-4ce1-b4fb-2b9c7656d30b both end as ADMITTED_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN with a broker job ID but no signed settlement.

Broker log records work_units=0, but HTTP omitted Livepeer-Work-Units; gateway returned protocol_response_invalid and request-ID recovery resolved ADMITTED_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN. LOC job fb66a0a2-1673-48d6-a96d-cced828a5bac. Still release-blocking.

title: Resolve paid-job settlement retention under revivable envelopes
description:
## Decision Required
paid-job 1.0.12 withdraws the prior simple 24-hour terminal-retention assumption and says brokers retain records for maximum envelope spendable life plus a dispute/recovery window. The same section establishes that governance can retroactively extend or revive tickets, making maximum spendable life unbounded absent an immutable protocol limit. Define a finite, enforceable retention or acknowledgement contract that lets LOC recover admitted settlements by request_id after restarts without requiring brokers to infer an impossible maximum.

## Rationale
Request-id recovery is useful only while the broker still retains the signed record. A retention formula with an unbounded governance input cannot be configured or tested, and the gateway's current 24-hour retrieval alerts would encode a superseded assumption.

## Alternatives Considered
Retain indefinitely; retain until LOC sends an authenticated acknowledgement; impose a conservative fixed minimum plus durable archival policy; or make ticket validity immutable at the protocol layer. Modules and LOC must choose a finite operational contract and define deletion safety.
acceptance_criteria: Modules and LOC publish one internally consistent retention rule for terminal settlement, accounting_pending, and non-admission records. It accounts for governance revival, specifies when retention begins and when a broker may delete, supports restart persistence and request-id lookup, and includes joint conformance. Any deletion acknowledgement authenticates LOC independently of the customer-known request_id and cannot be forged by the customer. Gateway retrieval deadlines and alerts are updated from the superseded 24-hour assumption. The contradictory paid-job 1.0.13 §5.3.1 refund language is also removed or explicitly made historical/non-normative.
notes:
At Modules 49ed891, paid-job §5.3 says automatic refund is unavailable and NOT_ADMITTED is audit-only, while §5.3.1 still says non-admission is evidence a refund requires and MUST NOT be acted on before expiry. The retention formula also uses an unbounded governance-revivable spendable lifetime. Current conformance remains 39 cases and does not exercise these semantics.
LOC agrees any deletion acknowledgement must authenticate LOC independently of request_id; request_id is customer-known and cannot authorize evidence deletion. At Modules 3999acc the stale §5.3.1 refund language and finite retention contract remain unresolved.
2026-08-22 source refresh: Modules 8d93a0a / paid-job 1.0.14-draft defines operational retention as conservative-charge deadline plus consumer recovery window plus margin, forbids eviction of in-flight/accounting-pending records, and preserves admission tombstones after detailed evidence eviction. Keep open until LOC deployment parameters and joint restart/eviction conformance prove the rule.

title: Add independently retrievable settlement lookup by request ID
description:
Allow LOC to recover an admitted paid-job's signed terminal settlement using the stable broker-facing request_id even when an untrusted caller withholds Livepeer-Job-Id. The broker already signs request_id into SettlementRecord, but the current lookup surface is keyed only by broker job id. This is an external Modules/LOC reconciliation contract; the gateway must not become the sole source of the broker job id or signed claim.

The lookup must distinguish no record/in-flight/accounting_pending/terminal settlement without confusing signed NOT_ADMITTED audit evidence with revocation or settlement.
acceptance_criteria: Modules publishes and implements an authenticated or appropriately scoped request-id lookup that returns the same durable signed terminal settlement and accounting states as job-id lookup. LOC consumes it idempotently and verifies the signed request_id against its job record. Joint conformance proves a caller can withhold Livepeer-Job-Id and settlement while LOC still recovers admitted work, including restart retention, accounting_pending, terminal success, DEBIT_FAILED, no-record, and cross-request isolation. Exact revisions are linked before release pinning.
notes:
Source review at Modules 49ed891 confirms current routes remain GET /v1/settlement/{job_id} and POST /v1/non-admission/{request_id}; there is no settlement-by-request-id route yet. paid-job 1.0.12 §5.3 terminal table correctly says NOT_ADMITTED is audit-only, but §5.3.1 still contains older contradictory refund-authority language. Coordinate correction with lmoa-3bv.24.
Modules half landed at 3999acc / paid-job 1.0.13-draft: GET /v1/exchange/{request_id} returns SETTLED (signed claim + job id), ACCOUNTING_PENDING, IN_FLIGHT, NOT_ADMITTED, or NO_RECORD. Broker server tests pass. Keep P0 open for LOC integration and restart/cross-request joint conformance; current executable protocol matrix remains 39 tests and does not exercise this route.
2026-08-22 source refresh: LOC request-id recovery landed at 6aa2d49 and is present in head a9a556c, including SETTLED and nonterminal/terminal outcome handling. Keep open for the required joint restart and cross-request conformance.

title: Execute the breaking paid-job/v1 cutover
description: Deploy the gateway against the pinned Modules and LOC v2 contracts as a deliberate breaking transition. Drain or otherwise disposition in-flight v0 reservations before deployment; do not run a dual protocol or fall back to v0.

title: Pin release-ready Modules and LOC v2 contract revisions

title: Define recovery for LOC jobs never admitted by a broker
description: Implement the finalized no-evidence recovery policy for LOC jobs that never produce a broker settlement. The deployed contract has no unconditional envelope expiry because governance can retroactively extend or revive tickets. There is no gateway abandon, automatic refund, or re-encumbrance path. LOC must preserve unresolved jobs and apply only the agreed auditable outcomes without fabricating broker usage or network debit.
acceptance_criteria: LOC and Modules contract revisions encode four distinguishable outcomes: valid broker-signed settlement; unresolved without terminal evidence; idempotent conservative_full_charge after an operational deadline; and signed NOT_ADMITTED retained as attributable audit evidence only. LOC persists issuance/deadline fields, observed chain telemetry, reason, and evidence; tests prove no automatic refund, abandon, re-encumbrance, fabricated units, or fabricated network debit. Gateway behavior and joint conformance match the final contract.
notes:
LOC confirmed 2026-08-21 that this is a P0 joint payer/payee release blocker. Assertion-based abandon and LOC-only timeout are explicitly rejected because an issued envelope could still be submitted after encumbrance release. Acceptable recovery must prove the payment is unspendable via revocation, authoritative no-debit plus envelope expiry, or equivalent daemon-supported evidence. Source: docs/references/2026-08-21-loc-paid-job-reply.md.
Modules c496fb4 provides creation_round and expires_after_round at mint; expiry after two rounds is the agreed unconditional non-spendability proof. LOC's current uncommitted working tree imports and persists both fields and rejects invalid expiry, but no code yet observes authoritative current round or idempotently releases an expired never-admitted reservation. Keep this P0 open until that behavior is landed, tested, and pinned.
2026-08-21 coordination update: LOC message says expiry authorizes release, but committed LOC bb41e45 says expiry only proves no future liability and is insufficient for automatic refund because work may have been delivered before expiry while settlement was withheld. It proposes fail-closed conservative full charge or independently retrievable broker evidence. Modules local working tree now exposes current_round through GetDepositInfo from the same clock as creation_round; targeted sender tests pass. Resolve the terminal accounting policy contradiction before closing this bead.
Modules authoritative current_round exposure has now landed at 6ad30b7, using the same clock as creation_round and requiring release only when current_round > expires_after_round; equality remains held. The remaining blocker is no longer daemon exposure—it is the LOC/joint terminal accounting policy and reconciler.
LOC confirmed the post-expiry threat model: expiry proves only that the envelope cannot be used in the future, not that it was never used before expiry. Refund-on-expiry lets an untrusted caller withhold settlement and obtain work plus a refund. Safe fallback is conservative full charge after expiry unless Modules supplies broker-signed non-admission evidence independently retrievable by LOC, preferably keyed by LOC request_id. No gateway implementation change is requested until the joint contract is resolved.
Final joint policy confirmed and codified in Modules paid-job 1.0.12-draft at 49ed891: there is no unconditional envelope expiry because governance can retroactively extend/revive tickets. LOC will implement no abandon, automatic refund, or re-encumbrance. Outcomes are valid signed settlement; unresolved with no terminal evidence; idempotent conservative_full_charge at an operational deadline; and signed NOT_ADMITTED retained only as attributable audit evidence. Conservative charge must preserve issuance/deadline telemetry, reason, and evidence without fabricating broker usage or network debit. Keep open until LOC implements/tests these states.
2026-08-22 live blocker reproduced against LOC 1.3.3/head 8e4ea2c: a fresh gateway stream open caused LOC to persist payment_idempotency_key 0160a294-eb9c-4fb3-99d7-3041d09c9cd0 as in_flight, return a retryable failure, then return IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS to the identical gateway retry. After several minutes the row remained in_flight with payment_id NULL and no payment row/envelope. Gateway correctly recorded customer outcome failed with no fabricated LOC/broker identity. Do not issue more test jobs until LOC fixes/reconciles this stale mint-claim crash window.
2026-08-22 rerun passed stale-claim recovery: exact original open for gateway key 0160a294-eb9c-4fb3-99d7-3041d09c9cd0 returned durable 409 IDEMPOTENCY_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; broker_request_id remained 298847ea-85ba-41e5-898f-170ea870f946; status is outcome_unknown, payment_id null, and no payment/accounting mutation exists. LOC reports job/session regression coverage for stale -> expired -> same-ID payer recovery -> permanent tombstone. Broader conservative-deadline/restart joint conformance still gates final close.

title: Resolve durable debit retry and DEBIT_FAILED lifecycle
description: Coordinate the Modules and LOC teams on the financially safe terminal lifecycle when broker work completed but clearinghouse debit has not. Prefer durable idempotent debit retry over treating response-header ordering as the primary release guarantee. Define how accounting_pending and signed DEBIT_FAILED evidence are represented and consumed.
acceptance_criteria: Modules and LOC agree and document that settlement lookup reports a nonterminal accounting_pending state while durable retry is active, then a signed terminal settlement after debit succeeds, or signed DEBIT_FAILED only after bounded exhaustion. LOC behavior for DEBIT_FAILED is explicit and cannot mark the reservation successfully settled or bill undebited value. The resulting contract is linked from this bead.
notes:
Coordinate against Modules bead lnm-y08. Known work-unit headers before debit are useful, but the gateway will query signed settlement for all transports and requires a durable financial outcome.
Resolved by Modules 818430c and LOC 258b36e. Broker returns 202 accounting_pending during durable same-sequence debit retry, then signs success or DEBIT_FAILED after configurable bounded exhaustion (default 10 attempts/30m). LOC rejects DEBIT_FAILED, keeps the payment session open, and does not bill or release the reservation. Modules paid-job conformance and broker smoke passed locally.
close_reason: Modules durable debit retry and accounting_pending contract landed at 818430c; LOC non-success handling for signed DEBIT_FAILED landed at 258b36e; upstream tests verified.

This is a clean cutover: do not retain v0 compatibility, dual parsing, fallback headers, or mode-based retry behavior.
design: Keep broker, daemon, worker, and LOC implementations behind their HTTP/protocol boundaries. Upstream revisions are conformance release gates, not runtime or build dependencies. The gateway owns its small multipart-audio-duration/v1 ceiling estimator locally because buyer-side funding calculation is gateway responsibility; it implements the catalog-advertised id/rounding/exactness contract and is verified against the protocol repository's shared fixture vectors. No Modules package or source tree is imported, linked, vendored, or required to build/deploy this service.

The old /v1/cap path, Livepeer-Mode, Livepeer-Spec-Version, mode inference, fresh-job mismatch retries, compensating settle(0), and forced stream_options.include_usage behavior are absent. Unary, multipart, and streaming paths persist authoritative signed settlements and settle LOC durably. Contract, regression, and signed cross-system conformance pass, documentation is current, and a breaking cutover runbook is ready.

Upstream baseline reviewed 2026-08-21: livepeer-network-modules tasks/lpm-v2 at f34d2d5 (implementation dcb8cc8), paid-job spec 1.0.7-draft and 39/39 broker conformance; LOC tasks/lpm-v2 committed head 0acadd7 plus active v2 working tree. title: Honor OpenAI output token ceilings in the Modules integration fixture
description: The localhost Modules OpenAI fixture ignores max_tokens. A stream request with max_tokens=8 had a gateway ceiling of 17 total tokens (prompt plus output), but the fixture emitted a 36-token response. Broker signed the measured 36 units and LOC correctly rejected settlement with usage_ceiling_exceeded. This makes tight-ceiling conformance fail for a reason unrelated to payment behavior and can leave the conservative LOC outcome in play.

title: Align debit retry schedule with the advertised reconciliation window
description:
## Decision Required
Resolve the mismatch between the Modules team's stated 10-attempt/30-minute debit recovery window and the reviewed broker implementation. capability-broker currently sweeps every 30 seconds and exhausts after 10 failed attempts or 30 minutes, so a continuous outage reaches DEBIT_FAILED in roughly five minutes and the age limit rarely governs. Decide the intended outage window and make the retry cadence/attempt/age policy operator-configurable or otherwise internally consistent.

## Rationale
A signed DEBIT_FAILED is an actual seller loss and a permanently unresolved LOC reservation, so the effective outage tolerance must be explicit and tested rather than implied by a max-age constant that cannot normally be reached.

## Alternatives Considered
Keep the current constants and describe the policy as roughly five minutes; spread 10 attempts across the full 30-minute window; or retain a 30-second cadence while raising/configuring the attempt cap. The Modules team should select and document the operational target with LOC input.
acceptance_criteria: Modules documents and tests one unambiguous retry schedule whose effective persistent-outage duration matches the agreed policy. Defaults and operator configuration are exposed consistently; mainnet recovery and exhaustion tests cover the timing semantics. The gateway/LOC coordination docs no longer call a roughly-five-minute attempt window a 30-minute reconciliation window.
notes: Modules current_round support landed concurrently at 6ad30b7; unrelated to this timing issue. Source still shows debitRetryInterval=30s, debitRetryMaxAttempts=10, debitRetryMaxAge=30m as compile-time constants.

close_reason: Deterministic paid-job/v1 coverage now exercises replay and idempotency failures, transport refusal before admission, signed evidence integrity and LOC rejection, request-ID recovery outcomes, accounting-pending/debit-failed paths, disconnect behavior, and fresh-worker restart recovery. Gateway test and build gates pass.

title: Configure endpoint work units, estimates, and funded ceilings
description: Define the product-level unit and conservative estimate/ceiling inputs per OpenAI endpoint, then map them to Modules extractors and catalog work units. Cover chat, embeddings, image generation, TTS, transcription, and rerank without scraping response bodies for settlement.
acceptance_criteria: Configuration and tests define chat prompt estimate plus output ceiling, embedding token estimate, image count, TTS Unicode codepoints, transcription duration, and rerank's agreed unit. Livepeer-Work-Unit drift is rejected locally. Every endpoint has a bounded max_total_units policy and documented over/under-estimate behavior.
notes:
Implemented and documented chat token estimate/output ceiling, embedding estimate/UTF-8 ceiling, exact image count, TTS Unicode code points, rerank request count, max_total_units propagation, and cached-catalog unit rejection. Transcription remains the only local blocker: broker settlement uses exact audio seconds, but LOC requires max_total_units before upload and this gateway currently does not parse duration. Need a product choice: add a local exact container parser, impose an explicit maximum-duration upload policy, or change the LOC/broker open flow so the seller can size the ceiling. Arbitrary byte-rate estimation is not safe across WAV/FLAC/MP4/Ogg/WebM/MP3. Headerless MP3 remains allow_inexact=false.
2026-08-22: Modules implemented the canonical exact-or-reject estimator at bfbe537 and LOC a9a556c already validates signed actual units against max_total_units. Remaining integration blockers are distribution and discovery, not protocol semantics: @livepeer-network/audio-duration is absent from npm and its git tree contains no dist/prepare artifact; LOC GET /v1/capabilities currently exposes work_unit as a string and drops the new estimator object. Do not commit a sibling-repo file: dependency or hardcode an unadvertised estimator.
2026-08-22 localhost clarification: linked the sibling Modules workspace package directly. Transcription now computes an exact positive whole-second ceiling before LOC open, passes it as both estimated_units and max_total_units, rejects unsupported/inexact media before reservation, and never records the estimate as settlement usage. The gateway test gate also runs Modules' 17 shared-fixture tests. Remaining blocker: LOC catalog must expose estimator metadata so the gateway can enforce advertised estimator identity rather than merely import the known package.
2026-08-22 live pilot: chat is operational. Gateway catalog now ignores unrelated paid-session offerings and transcription fails before reservation/LOC open while LOC a9a556c omits estimator metadata. Gateway-side estimator parser and exact-contract enforcement are complete at d986619; lmoa-3bv.26 remains the sole transcription discovery blocker.
2026-08-22 architecture correction: the estimator implementation is now owned inside this gateway. The linked @livepeer-network/audio-duration package, sibling source-tree build hooks, Docker additional context, and absolute runtime copy were removed. Clean pnpm and Docker builds pass without Modules present. Catalog matching intentionally binds only estimator id, rounding, and exactness; package/fixture fields are informational. LOC estimator propagation (lmoa-3bv.26) remains the transcription readiness blocker.
2026-08-22 conformance hardening: gateway CI now regenerates all 13 published multipart-audio-duration/v1 vectors byte-for-byte, pins their SHA-256 hashes, and verifies the 7 exact ceilings plus 6 required refusals. Ogg/Opus remains an additional local case. Gateway suite is 125/125. This removes the last local estimator-conformance gap.
close_reason: All endpoint funding policies are implemented and tested. Transcription locally computes the exact 3-second ceiling from the shared vector and successfully opens a matching LOC multipart job. Remaining failure is external ticket-EV/broker terminal evidence, tracked separately as lmoa-3bv.28 and .27.

title: Migrate streaming chat without buffering
description: Stream broker SSE bytes to the OpenAI client as they arrive while retaining enough durable identity to retrieve signed settlement after stream termination. Do not buffer the transcript or mutate stream_options.include_usage to manufacture a claim. Handle client disconnect, broker termination at the funded ceiling, and missing trailers.
acceptance_criteria: Time-to-first-byte and incremental delivery remain streaming; the gateway does not buffer the full response. On normal end, broker error, funded-ceiling termination, or client disconnect, it durably schedules authoritative settlement lookup and LOC settlement. Tests cover missing/unreadable trailers and show that accounting completes after the client connection is gone.
close_reason: Streaming chat now forwards the caller body unchanged, pipes SSE incrementally without transcript buffering, and relies exclusively on the already-durable broker settlement lookup after normal end, broker error, missing trailers, or client disconnect. Added a transport test proving the handle and first bytes arrive before completion without terminal trailers; 87 tests pass.

title: Migrate unary and multipart OpenAI endpoints
description: Route chat non-streaming, embeddings, images, TTS, transcription, rerank, and other applicable one-shot endpoints through the v2 LOC and broker clients while preserving OpenAI-compatible request and response behavior. Keep request bodies semantically unchanged except for transport-required serialization.
acceptance_criteria: All unary and multipart endpoints use paid-job/v1 only, validate the selected offering's declared transport and work unit, obtain signed settlement evidence, and enqueue durable LOC settlement on success and terminal errors. Non-streaming non-2xx claims zero units. Endpoint tests cover success, typed refusal, upstream error, timeout, and replay.
notes: Terminal non-2xx broker responses now retain Livepeer-Job-Id immediately when present and must carry the LOC-selected work unit plus Livepeer-Work-Units: 0. Pre-admission refusals without a job id continue through request-id recovery. Regression coverage added; 95 gateway tests pass.
close_reason: All unary and multipart OpenAI routes dispatch only through paid-job/v1 with declared transport/work-unit validation and durable signed-settlement recovery. Terminal errors retain broker identity and enforce zero work units; multipart preserves its content type and uses /v1/job. Shared endpoint/dispatch tests cover success, typed refusal, upstream failure, timeout, replay, identity drift, and work-unit drift. Transcription ceiling calculation remains separately tracked in lmoa-3bv.15. Lint and 96 tests pass.

title: Implement accounting-only replay and lost-response handling
description: Handle the normative paid-job/v1 replay response, which reproduces accounting identity and claims but not the original OpenAI payload. Complete signed settlement retrieval and LOC accounting for the already executed job, then return a stable OpenAI-compatible upstream_response_lost error. Never submit a new paid job automatically.
acceptance_criteria: A retry after an ambiguous response converges on the original broker job and LOC reservation, persists and settles its signed claim, and returns a documented OpenAI-shaped 5xx error when the original payload is unavailable. Tests prove there is no second backend execution, second debit, new request ID, or hidden resubmission.
close_reason: Unary/multipart replay bodies and non-SSE stream replay responses are detected as accounting-only outcomes after the original job identity is durably scheduled. The gateway returns OpenAI-shaped 502 upstream_response_lost via the existing error mapper and never opens or submits a second job. Integration tests prove one LOC open, one broker call, stable job identity, and no hidden resubmission.

title: Expand durable reservation and settlement evidence storage
description: Evolve the durable job/settlement queue so recovery does not depend on process memory or an OpenAI response body. Persist all correlation identities, protocol and transport, work unit, broker-claimed and debited units, optional observed units, signed settlement envelope, lookup/accounting state, attempts, and terminal error evidence.
acceptance_criteria: A forward Drizzle migration preserves existing records while adding the v2 fields and constraints. A restart at any point can resume broker settlement lookup and LOC settlement idempotently. Unit or identity drift is recorded and rejected rather than coerced. Database and repository tests cover migration and recovery states.
notes: LOC requires all five distinct identifiers plus the complete signed claim. Settlement lookup intent, attempts, next-attempt state, and claim persistence must survive restart. Do not encode a 24-hour deadline: Modules' finite-retention/authenticated-deletion contract remains unresolved in lmoa-3bv.24. The bounded LOC settle retry budget must not govern pre-persistence lookup.
close_reason: Added forward-only paid-job evidence migration and repository lifecycle storage for all identities, exact signed envelopes, distinct usage authorities, restart lookup state, and drift rejection. Gateway lint/tests pass (78/78), and all migrations apply cleanly on isolated PostgreSQL 16.

title: Implement authoritative settlement lookup and durable LOC settlement
description: For every transport, retrieve the signed broker settlement by broker job ID and persist it before settling the LOC reservation. Treat stream trailers and unary/multipart work-unit headers as useful observations, not authoritative proof. Support nonterminal accounting states and terminal failure evidence without losing the reservation.
acceptance_criteria: Unary, multipart, and stream paths query settlement until a signed terminal outcome or defined terminal failure. Signature material and all bound IDs, units, price, quote, and request ID are passed to LOC exactly as required. accounting_pending is retried durably; tampering, cross-job evidence, work-unit drift, and DEBIT_FAILED receive explicit non-success handling; retries never double settle.
notes:
LOC confirms 409 job_already_settled is terminal financial success after a lost response but not an exact response replay; retain the original signed claim. Invalid signature, quote/request mismatch, cross-job claim, and work-unit mismatch are permanent. Retry transient LOC/database failures with the identical payload.
Modules 818430c fixes the upstream state machine: retry GET /v1/settlement/{jobId} on 202 Livepeer-Error=accounting_pending without consuming the terminal LOC settlement retry budget. Default broker retry exhaustion is 10 attempts/30m, configurable. Signed DEBIT_FAILED remains an explicit fault and LOC 258b36e rejects it.
Correction after source review: the broker constants are a 30-second retry interval, 10-attempt cap, and 30-minute age cap. They are compile-time constants in the reviewed implementation, not operator configuration. Under persistent failure the attempt cap reaches DEBIT_FAILED in roughly five minutes. Track policy alignment under lmoa-3bv.22.
paid-job 1.0.12 supersedes the previously accepted 24-hour terminal retention with max envelope spendable life plus dispute/recovery window. Because governance can revive tickets, that maximum is not currently finite. Do not implement a hard 24-hour terminal deadline until lmoa-3bv.24 resolves the retention/acknowledgement contract. Persist and retry promptly regardless.
close_reason: Gateway reconciliation implementation is complete; external LOC policy/release gates remain open separately in lmoa-3bv.3/.23/.24. All endpoints persist identities before broker delivery; restart-safe lookup retrieves signed evidence by job or request ID; accounting_pending is durable; NOT_ADMITTED/expired/DEBIT_FAILED remain non-success; LOC receives the identical signed claim. Lint, 94 tests, and isolated PostgreSQL migrations pass.

title: Implement the paid-job/v1 broker transport client
description: Send work to POST /v1/job with Livepeer-Protocol: paid-job/v1, required Livepeer-Request-Id, unchanged capability/offering/payment fields, and ordinary HTTP transport selection. Capture Livepeer-Job-Id and unit metadata without assuming body ownership or replaying as a fresh paid job.
acceptance_criteria: Unary, text/event-stream, and multipart requests select transport through Accept or Content-Type and reject protocol_transport_unsupported before payment. The client sends no Livepeer-Mode or Livepeer-Spec-Version headers, never calls /v1/cap, never creates a fresh LOC job for a mode mismatch, and handles job_in_flight and request_id_reuse as typed outcomes.
close_reason: Unary, stream, and multipart broker drivers now use POST /v1/job, paid-job/v1 headers and HTTP transport negotiation; dispatch uses LOC's broker request ID, captures broker job/work-unit metadata, rejects drift, and never opens compensating fresh jobs.

title: Migrate the LOC client to v2 paid-job reservations and idempotent opens
description: Replace the old LOC job-open and settle DTOs with the v2 reservation contract. Supply a stable Idempotency-Key and preserve the returned LOC job ID, broker request ID, work ID, protocol, transport, work unit, broker URL, payment envelope, and settle endpoint across retries.
acceptance_criteria: Identical retry attempts converge on one LOC reservation and one broker request identity. The client validates protocol, transport, unit, IDs, and URLs, rejects drift, and exposes typed pre-admission and accounting states. Tests cover timeout retry, key reuse with different content, and malformed responses.
notes: 2026-08-22 live crash-window follow-up: LOC may return IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS after a retryable first open failure. Gateway now treats that typed 409 as retryable, preserves identical content/key, and spaces all retryable opens with bounded exponential backoff. Unit coverage proves a short in-flight state can converge without a fresh job. A permanently stale LOC claim still fails after the configured attempt budget and remains an external lmoa-3bv.3 blocker.
close_reason: LOC open/settle client now matches the breaking v2 DTO, preserves large wire integers losslessly, requires and validates signed settlement evidence, rejects identity/unit drift, and retains typed refusal codes. Timeout retries reuse identical key/content; tests pass.

title: Migrate catalog and model persistence to protocol and transports
description: Replace interaction-mode catalog assumptions with required protocol and declared transport metadata. Update catalog parsing, persistence, model projection, cache refresh, and offering selection so one offering can advertise unary, stream, and multipart without per-mode duplication.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog ingestion rejects missing or unsupported protocol metadata, stores paid-job/v1 plus declared transports, and exposes each offering once through /v1/models. No interactionMode, interaction_mode, stream-suffix offering selection, or guessInteractionMode logic remains in active code or schemas.
close_reason: Catalog parsing, route resolution, model persistence migration, admin/portal projections, and tests now use required paid-job/v1 protocol plus declared transports; model IDs are LOC offering IDs.

title: Define broker-claimed versus gateway-observed usage semantics
description: Define separate meanings and persistence for the seller's signed broker claim and any gateway-observed or customer-facing usage. paid-job/v1 settlement proves the broker claim; it is not automatically the buyer's billing meter. The current beta has no customer billing, but diagnostics must not conflate these values.
acceptance_criteria: A checked-in decision names the fields, authority, display rules, and disagreement handling for broker-claimed, debited, and optional gateway-observed units. No code or UI labels a broker claim as customer-billed usage without an explicit future product decision.
close_reason: Claimed, debited, LOC-settled, and gateway-observed usage fields, authorities, display rules, and divergence behavior recorded in docs/design-docs/paid-job-v1.md.

title: Land the transcription duration metering contract
description: Choose and land an authoritative paid-job/v1 extractor for transcription duration. Because this gateway does not own capability workers, prefer a Modules multipart-audio-duration extractor unless Modules establishes and enforces a mandatory runner response-header contract across every eligible offering.
acceptance_criteria: The Modules team publishes an extractor or normative runner contract that produces the agreed transcription duration unit for all advertised offerings. Invalid or unsupported audio is handled before payment or produces zero units on terminal non-2xx. Gateway configuration and tests can consume the contract without inspecting worker-specific response bodies.
notes:
Coordinate against Modules bead lnm-4xh. This repository must not gain a local worker implementation merely to measure duration.
Resolved by Modules 12fa0db / lnm-4xh: multipart-audio-duration supports WAV, FLAC, MP4/M4A, Ogg Opus/Vorbis, WebM, and MP3. Exact seconds round up. Headerless MP3 CBR duration is inexact and refused by default unless allow_inexact is explicitly enabled. Gateway should keep allow_inexact=false and add representative format fixtures.
close_reason: Modules multipart-audio-duration extractor and contract landed at 12fa0db; supported exact formats and default refusal of inexact MP3 satisfy the gateway decision.

title: Update v2 architecture, reliability, deployment, and operator docs
description: Update the repository system of record for the paid-job/v1 architecture and breaking rollout. Document correlation IDs, transport negotiation, funded ceilings, settlement authority, durable recovery, accounting-only replay, operational diagnostics, and known external contract ownership.
acceptance_criteria: DESIGN/ARCHITECTURE, product surface, RELIABILITY, DEPLOYMENT, active exec plan, and relevant operator docs agree with implemented v2 behavior. They state there is no v0 compatibility, explain upstream_response_lost and settlement recovery, identify pinned external revisions, and include troubleshooting queries that do not expose secrets.
notes: 2026-08-22 docs/runtime alignment: documented that request outcome is independent of financial outcome; removed the false refunded state from architecture, reliability, product, deployment, admin and portal surfaces. External pins and complete joint conformance remain before this documentation gate can close.

title: Replace mode-based admin and portal diagnostics
description: Update gateway APIs and zero-build admin/portal views to show paid-job/v1 protocol, transport, identities, units, settlement lookup state, and accounting outcomes rather than interaction mode or body-derived usage.
acceptance_criteria: Diagnostics display protocol and transport separately, distinguish claimed/debited/observed units, expose accounting_pending and terminal failures, and redact signed/payment secrets. No active UI or API field depends on interaction_mode or stream offering duplication.
close_reason: Admin and portal diagnostics now expose paid-job protocol/transport, safe correlation identities, independent observed/actual/debited/settled units, accounting-pending and terminal states, while withholding signed envelopes and payment credentials. Gateway lint and 94 tests pass.
